CATEGORY: 2
REASONING: This issue involves missing libraries when using the Sharp module after an Arch Linux update. The problem is that Sharp is looking for specific versions of libraries (libIlmImf-2_3.so.24, etc.) but the system now has newer versions (libIlmImf-2_4.so.24). This is a dependency/library version mismatch issue that requires a build environment to verify any solution. The solution would likely involve rebuilding Sharp against the newer libraries or creating appropriate symlinks. This can be easily dockerized by creating a container with Arch Linux and the specific library versions to reproduce and test the issue. Since it's just a matter of library dependencies within a Linux environment, there are no special hardware requirements, external API dependencies, or other factors that would make dockerization difficult.
